decisions.reason: The email-to-SMS gateway sits close to the core messaging offer, uses existing infrastructure at low marginal cost, and still has its own web page; with a growing industry and ample slack in a large firm, there is no shortfall against aspiration that would trigger dropping it after only one year.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B and the core communication platform, so slack allows the firm to carry it while results remain uncertain, though the earlier withdrawal of the inbound SMS API shows some risk that SMS features get consolidated.
